name: Landmark-based Head Pose Estimation Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation protocol for estimating head pose from facial landmark and image data.
reputation: Moderately used in head-pose estimation research as a focused benchmark for landmark-based methods, but not as widely adopted as larger image-only datasets.
notes: Small/specialized dataset focused on landmark-based head-pose estimation (non-LLM). Performance sensitive to landmark detection quality and dataset diversity; reported results use angular error metrics.
